description: Three fictional campaign briefs for demonstrating brand-grounded campaign generation, compliance checks, and semantic deduplication.

briefs.targetAudience: Small business teams and project managers
briefs.campaignGoal: Encourage teams to explore a clearer approach to organizing priorities.
keyMessages: Help teams plan their next steps.
prohibitedClaims: Do not invent customer testimonials or statistics.
Do not claim that the product eliminates every workplace problem.

briefs.targetAudience: Households interested in reducing everyday waste
briefs.campaignGoal: Introduce reusable household products and encourage customers to learn about practical alternatives.
keyMessages: Small everyday choices can be worth exploring.
Explain product materials and intended uses clearly.
Help customers make informed purchasing decisions.
prohibitedClaims: Do not claim that a product has zero environmental impact without evidence.
Do not invent certifications or sustainability statistics.
Do not promise specific environmental outcomes.

briefs.campaignGoal: Encourage learners to explore practical courses and identify a skill they want to develop.
keyMessages: Learning can start with one manageable step.
Explore courses that match your interests.
Describe course content and outcomes accurately.
prohibitedClaims: Do not guarantee employment, salary increases, or promotions.
Do not fabricate graduate outcomes or employer endorsements.
Do not claim that every learner will achieve the same result.
